newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Soros cuts Sydney Casino stake further.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Soros cuts Sydney Casino stake further.

text.p: The funds of international investor George Soros said late on Thursday they further reduced their stake in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd to 5.04 percent from 7.62 percent on Wednesday.
Various Soros funds, including Soros Capital and the Quantum funds, said the holding in the casino had been reduced to 19.55 million shares from 29.55 million shares on Wednesday.
The Soros funds earlier on Thursday said they had cut their shareholding from 8.65 percent between August 20 and November 8.
Sydney Harbour Casino, 26.3 percent owned by Showboat Inc, has been the subject of heavy trade in recent days, including turnover of 11 million shares on Wednesday and 4.5 million on Thursday.
Sydney Harbour Casino shares closed steady at A$1.90.
